title: From Text to Discovery: How Large Language Models Are Accelerating and Complicating Research Across Scientific and Humanistic Disciplines

bias_targets.methodology: Thematic analysis of literature documenting how LLMs reinforce dominant paradigms and entrenched theories, particularly in hypothesis generation and literature synthesis.
Systematic scoping review of research identifying biases inherited from large-scale training corpora and historical data that perpetuate outdated or unethical practices.
Synthesis of cross-disciplinary evidence regarding the reproduction of structural inequalities and the amplification of dominant narratives or biases against marginalized communities.
Evaluation of studies reporting the limited representation of global psychological and social diversity in model training and outputs.
Analysis of systemic risks related to 'unequal access' to LLM technologies between well-funded institutions and low-income regions.
Review of findings related to systemic distortions in model-driven decision-support systems, particularly in fields like healthcare and political science.
